title: Vikram and Betal: The Three Friends

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story to Vikram.
scenes.text: As Vikram carried Betal, he told a story about three friends on a journey.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The three friends found a man lying unconscious in the forest.
scenes.image_prompt: three friends finding unconscious man in forest cartoon

scenes.text: One used intelligence, one bravery, and one kindness to help the man.
scenes.image_prompt: friends helping man together teamwork cartoon

scenes.summary: The man wants to reward one friend.
scenes.text: The man could not decide who deserved the reward the most.
scenes.image_prompt: man offering reward looking confused cartoon

scenes.text: Vikram said all deserved the reward equally. Betal agreed and flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: betal flying away while vikram stands calm cartoon

story: Betal told a story about three friends who saved a man using intelligence, bravery, and kindness. When asked who deserved a reward, Vikram said all of them did. Betal agreed and flew back to the tree.
